_note: SIX VARIANTS, FIRED THROUGH THE PRODUCT PATH. The toasts are not markup a
fixture can hand over: `useHistoryFeedback` subscribes to three engine
events and composes each message from a label table. So the probe gives it
a two-method event bus in place of a Composer and emits the six histories
the board draws — undo of a delete, a text edit and a move; redo of a
delete; undo of a style change; and ⌘Z on an empty stack. Every string,
tone, duration and reverse link measured here is produced by the shipping
hook. They are addressed per variant (`toast-body-0` … `-5`), which is the
queue order, so the six are measured as six.
BOARD WON, three times — and this is the substance of the row:
814:7032  the toast is DARK. All six frames are filled --color/ink with
the message in --flowbite/gray/200. It shipped as `info`, the
same pale accent-tint card a 'publish queued' notice uses. A
sixth Toast tone, `dark`, carries the ground, the ink and a
readable action together; the five tinted tones board 1177:4859
catalogues are untouched, and each now carries its own ink so
no two utilities fight for `color` on a plain element.
814:7032  ONE line, 36 tall on an 8 radius at 11px. It shipped two lines
(a '↩ Undo' title over the sentence) inside 12/12 padding with
32-high flowbite buttons, which measured 56. The message is now
'Undo: Deleted element' on a single centred row and the two
controls are inline links. Measured after: 36 tall, radius 8,
ink ground — 814:7032's three geometry numbers, exactly.
814:7060  the empty-stack toast is dark too. Its CAPTION reads 'Grey
toast, no action', but the frame that caption describes
(814:7062) is filled --color/ink like the other five. The
drawing is the design; the caption describes it (the same
ruling LEDGER J-164:22 makes about note blocks). What the
caption's second half says IS honoured: no reverse action.
NOT CONFORMED — the reverse link's colour. 814:7034 draws it #80B2FF, which
is not a token; the nearest step in the generated scale is --bk-blue-300
#A4CAFE, and Gate 16's hex ratchet over chrome may only go down. Measured on
